names: a page's analysis_as_of is the latest date at which every input is knowable: each CIQ export's own stated export date is recorded in the input record (inputs.ciq[].export_date, the comps workbook's As-Of Date header, read raw) and counted, so a page is never dated before its CIQ inputs were exported; date_semantics names it (ciq_exported_as_of) and states the rule it then follows. A page whose record states no export date keeps its block word for word
